<details>
The PKGBUILD defines a standard AUR package build process for `jpegli-tools-git`, a set of JPEG encoding/decoding tools from Google's jpegli project. It fetches source code from two trusted upstream repositories: `https://github.com/google/jpegli.git` and `https://github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo.git`. Both sources are referenced directly via Git, which is appropriate for `-git` packages.

The build process uses CMake to compile only the required tools (`cjpegli`, `djpegli`) and manpages, with all unnecessary components (fuzzers, benchmarks, JNI, etc.) explicitly disabled. The `prepare()` function configures a submodule to use the locally checked-out libjpeg-turbo source, avoiding network access during build—this improves reproducibility and is a sound packaging practice. All checksums are marked as 'SKIP', which is expected and acceptable for VCS-based packages where content is inherently mutable.

No suspicious operations such as unauthorized network requests, obfuscated code, or unexpected file system modifications are present. The package installs only binaries, manpages, and license files into standard directories. There is no evidence of malicious behavior, backdoors, or supply-chain attacks.
</details>

Those are out of scope for this narrow gate and will be audited separately. There is no top-level download, curl/wget, eval, base64 decoding, or data exfiltration.
</details>
